chunks: Except those who believe, and do good and enjoin truth on one another, and enjoin one another to bear with fortitude (the trials that befall).

key_terms.إِيمَان: Faith or belief in God and the prophetic mission
key_terms.التَّوَاصِي: Mutual enjoining or advising one another
key_terms.الصَّبْرِ: Patience or perseverance in the face of hardship

ai.seo_question: What are the four conditions for success mentioned in Surah Al-Asr?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often viewed as a concise encapsulation of the entire Quran, where 'mutual enjoining of truth' (Tawassu bi'l-Haqq) is closely linked to the concept of Wilayah and the guidance of the Ahl al-Bayt, while 'patience' (Sabr) refers specifically to enduring the trials of the Imams. The pairing of these four elements underscores that true faith is not merely individualistic but requires active communal cohesion and perseverance in upholding divine justice.
